channel.description: A 23-chapter handbook for Claude Code — permissions, context, skills, hooks, MCP and agents, worked out end to end for engineers who have to ship with it.

item.title: Three Ways to Talk to Claude Code
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Claude Code accepts input through three channels — CLI flags, slash commands and in-prompt sigils — distinguished by when they are parsed and whether they reach the model. Full flag and command reference, shell-mode semantics, and the input handling layer.
